race.title: Maria's And Aidie's 25th Wedding Anniversary Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Cases can be made for a few of these, but ASTA LA VISTA ran his best race when finishing runner-up at Bangor back in the spring and with this extra distance a possible catalyst for further progress, Tom Britten's new recruit is taken to get off the mark. County Champs has had plenty of goes and he may have to settle for another silver medal, with Charles Morin and Black Dakota taken to fight out third. ASTA LA VISTA COUNTY CHAMPS (IRE) CHARLES MORIN
race.bettingForecast: County Champs (3/1), Charles Morin (7/2), Asta La Vista (4/1), Vendant (7/1), Black Dakota (8/1), Ami Bondhu (10/1), Hawa Jumeirah (12/1), One For Rian (14/1), Court One (33/1), Lily Grace (33/1), Always Force It (50/1)
